name: Fiberglass batt R-13
description: Kraft-faced fiberglass batt, R-13 at 3 1/2in, for 2x4 walls. Friction fit between studs.
source: Owens Corning EcoTouch specification 07 21 16: R-13 3 1/2in, R-19 6 1/4in, R-30 9 1/2in. Density about 0.7 pcf is typical; manufacturers publish none.

name: Fiberglass batt R-19
description: Kraft-faced fiberglass batt, R-19 at 6 1/4in, for 2x6 walls and floors.
source: Owens Corning EcoTouch specification 07 21 16: R-13 3 1/2in, R-19 6 1/4in, R-30 9 1/2in. Density about 0.7 pcf is typical; manufacturers publish none.

name: Fiberglass batt R-30
description: Fiberglass batt, R-30 at about 10in, for ceilings and roofs.
source: Owens Corning EcoTouch specification 07 21 16: R-13 3 1/2in, R-19 6 1/4in, R-30 9 1/2in. Density about 0.7 pcf is typical; manufacturers publish none.

name: Mineral wool batt R-15
description: Stone wool batt (ComfortBatt type), R-15 at 3 1/2in, for 2x4 walls. Fire- and moisture-resistant.
source: ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt US technical data sheet: R-15 at 3.5in, R-23 at 5.5in; density > 1.8 pcf (ASTM C167)

name: Mineral wool batt R-23
description: Stone wool batt, R-23 at 5 1/2in, for 2x6 walls.
source: ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt US technical data sheet: R-15 at 3.5in, R-23 at 5.5in; density > 1.8 pcf (ASTM C167)

name: Rigid foam, XPS
description: Extruded polystyrene board, R-5 per inch: under slabs, on foundation walls and over sheathing.
source: ASTM C578-23 Type IV XPS (e.g. Foamular 250), via Owens Corning technical bulletin: R-5.0 per inch, density ≥ 1.45 pcf

name: Rigid foam, polyiso
description: Foil-faced polyisocyanurate board, about R-6 per inch: over sheathing and under roofs (not below grade).
source: Johns Manville AP Foil-Faced data sheet (ASTM C1289 Type I Class 1): R-6.0 at 1in, aged; density 2.0 pcf nominal (Rmax Durasheath data sheet)

name: Rigid foam, EPS
description: Expanded polystyrene board, about R-4 per inch: the cheapest rigid foam.
source: ASTM C578 Type II EPS, via Owens Corning technical bulletin and the EPS Industry Alliance table: R-4.0 per inch, density ≥ 1.35 pcf
